title: DNA Extraction for college laboratory setting
author: James M. Burnette III
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.dwu7ev

steps.title: Label tubes for each plant
steps.instruction: Label one tube for each plant sample.

steps.title: Harvest and grind seedlings in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Harvest 2–3 seedlings per sample, place them in a mortar, add about 50 ml liquid nitrogen, and grind the tissue with a pestle.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml extraction buffer to each labeled tube.

steps.title: Add SDS and mix on ice
steps.instruction: Add 120 µl of 10 % SDS, mix by inverting, and if preparing multiple samples keep each tube on ice after this step.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 65 °C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Add KOAc, mix, ice incubation
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl of 5 M KOAc, mix well by inverting several times, then place the tubes on ice for 5 minutes. Samples may be frozen for later use; thaw before the next step.

steps.title: Centrifuge and transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes for 5 minutes at >12 000 rpm, label a second tube, and pass 700 µl of the supernatant through a miracloth funnel into the second tube.

substeps.instruction: Pass 700 µl supernatant through miracloth funnel into second tube

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl isopropanol to the transferred supernatant and mix thoroughly by inverting. Samples may be frozen for later use.

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Spin the mixture for 5 minutes at 14 000 rpm, carefully discard the supernatant, and use a P20 pipette set to 20 µl to remove any remaining liquid without disturbing the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Use P20 set to 20 µl to remove residual liquid

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl of 70 % ethanol, flick the tube until the pellet detaches from the bottom, then spin for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Flick tube until pellet comes off the bottom

steps.title: Centrifuge and remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Pour off the ethanol, then use a P20 pipette set to 20 µl to remove any remaining drops without disturbing the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Use P20 set to 20 µl to remove residual drops

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in TE and store
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 50 µl TE, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes for complete resuspension, and freeze the sample for storage.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 5 min
